title: IEC 60870-5-104 TESTFR activation U-format
purpose: Provide a clean U-format parser entry for 104 test handling without malformed ASDU mixing.
expected_behavior: A 104 peer should recognize a valid TESTFR activation U-format APDU and either accept it as a keepalive/test control frame or answer with the corresponding TESTFR confirmation.
constraints_preserved: Uses IEC 60870-5-104 APDU start byte 0x68 from supplied source
Uses standard 104 U-format shape with 4 control bytes and no ASDU
Length octet 0x04 matches the 4-byte control field exactly
No FT1.2 checksum, repeated-length, or end-delimiter fields were mixed into this 104 frame
issue_safety_notes: PK-only seed; no historical exploit payload retained. This is a safe structural control-frame analogue chosen to replace malformed prior test examples.
